Success in this position requires the ability to translate quantitative and qualitative data into actionable strategies; and the ability to build strong cross-functional partnerships with Merchandise Planning, Merchandising, Logistics, Store Operations, and the Field. **What You'll Do** * Drive the seasonal inventory allocation strategies that support the product, investment strategies, and commercial plan strategies * Execute initial inventory releases; ensure consistent and profitable in-season replenishment. * Within the purchase order process, inform team of divisional strategies for packing, pre-packs, size balancing and inventory balancing within multiple pools of inventory. * Sponsor analysis and cross-functional partnerships that will identify and quantify size selling, geographic and store-attribute opportunities; ensure follow through on execution of strategies. * Drive profitability through leading and executing promotional and markdown strategies which align with divisional and brand financial goals * Manage Basics forecast, allocation and service levels for one or more departments * Serve as a brand SME for inventory process improvements and brand projects * Drive profitability through leading and executing promotional and markdown strategies which align with divisional and brand financial goals. * Deliver results through everyday management of the business that align to the overall brand strategy, resulting in increased earnings and financial success. **Who You Are** * Minimum 3 to 5 years inventory management experience * Excellent verbal and writing skills in English is required, and in Japanese is preferred * Four-year college degree or equivalent required * Ability to evaluate financial and business indicators and translate data into actionable recommendations to **Drive for Results** * Keep **Customer Focus** in mind when making decisions * **Talent Builder** : Ability to hire, train, develop, and motivate direct reports * **Collaboration & Influencing** : Ability to build constructive relationships with a broad range of business partners; can presentideas and direction that lead others to action *Gap集團為員工提供公平就業機會，並致力於提供無騷擾、無歧視的工作環境。 我們承諾招募、錄取、訓練及升遷所有符合資格的員工，不考量相關身分背景。在決定是否錄取時，也不會考慮應徵者是否具有任何特殊身分。 我們因長期致力於平等而獲獎無數，並將繼續營造一個多元、包容且歸屬感強的環境。 今年，我們連續第17年被人權運動組織評選為“最佳工作場所”之一（a href="https://www.hrc.org/resources/best-places-to-work-for-lgbtq-equality-2022"），同時公司還被納入2021年彭博性別平等指數（ ），這也是公司連續第四年被納入該指數。*

Specific processes and policies include: supplier payment terms, Non-Recurring Expense, and Cost of Goods. * Support for Supplier financial risk assessment and identify business and financial risks while guiding Sourcing in supplier risk management. * Provide financial support to SS&P Asia business and new initiatives , contributing to the strategic target of increasing Asia’s share of global spending from 3% to 15%, in alignment with the company’s Asia supply chain development program, and also China local for local project. * Aligning with the Business Lines and cross-sector stakeholders in Asia and Veldhoven, being the bridge builder among sectors and business lines, with independent (finance) view on what is best for the company as a whole * Other management reporting & analysis as needed **Education and experience** * Master's Degree, Business administration, Data Analytics, Management * At least 10 years related working experience **Skills** * Hands on, team player, enjoys working in a multidisciplinary and multicultural environment with the ability to work independently * Must be able to read and interpret data, information, and documents. * Ability to complete assignments with attention to detail and high degree of accuracy. * Familiarity with tools used to build data visualizations. Example software: Spotfire, , Power BI, , , SAP * Proficiency (expert) in Microsoft Office: Excel, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams, Forms * Has integrity and is compliance-minded * Detail-oriented * Multi-disciplinary and multi-cultural understanding * Strong relationship building skills * Self-driven and ambitious * Getting things done in a large organization * Ability to influence without power * Strategic thinking and business acumen skills * Creative in managing a large and diverse range of stakeholders * Takes ownership of issues from start to completion * Able to provide an unbiased view on business priorities * Observe the wishes and needs of the customer, manage expectation and then act accordingly * Strong passion for technology **Inclusion and diversity** ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. new_jobs.title: [L'OREAL Taiwan] E-Marketing Assistant Manager
new_jobs.jd: A Day in the Life We are seeking a dynamic E-Marketing Assistant Manager to join our team in Taipei. You will be instrumental in developing and executing the brand's digital marketing and e-commerce strategies. * Brand E-commerce & Performance Analysis: You will manage the brand’s own e-commerce platforms, analyzing performance data and key metrics to optimize the consumer journey, drive online sales growth, and maximize ROI. * E-KA Channel Strategy: You will develop and execute bespoke digital marketing strategies for our e-Key Account (E-KA) channels, acting as a key marketing advisor to drive growth and strengthen brand presence within L'Oréal's own e-commerce ecosystem. * Digital Ecosystem Growth: You will identify new trends and opportunities across the entire digital landscape (brand site, social, and E-KA) to propose innovative initiatives that keep Kiehl's at the forefront of the market. We Are Looking For You are a great match for this role if you are a digitally-savvy marketer with a strong understanding of the beauty landscape and a drive to achieve results. We are looking for an individual with an entrepreneurial mindset and a strong capacity for collaboration. * Over 5 years of proven experience in digital marketing or e-commerce, ideally within the beauty or consumer goods industry or online pure players. * Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate data into actionable strategies. * Excellent communication and project management skills, able to work effectively in a fast-paced environment. * Business proficiency in English.

new_jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Anti-Scam Innovation Team)
new_jobs.jd: **About Us** Gogolook is a leading TrustTech company founded in 2012 and listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange in 2025 under the stock code 6902. With "Build for Trust" as its core value, the company has expanded its business from Asia to Europe and America. Gogolook’s AI technology is built on the world's largest database of digital scam data, encompassing phone numbers, websites, virtual currency wallet addresses, and other factors. The company provides diverse anti-scam and fintech services for both consumers and businesses. Its anti-scam offerings include the digital anti-scam app "Whoscall" and a range of enterprise scam prevention solutions in combination with "ScamAdviser." The Fintech BU empowers consumers through data-driven financial services and inclusive lending: Roo.Cash（袋鼠金融）offers transparent matchmaking for financial products like credit cards, while JUJI（招財麻吉）provides an innovative microloan service for rapid, convenient funding during urgent financial needs. A foundation member of the Global Anti-Scam Alliance (GASA), Gogolook has also teamed up with a number of institutes such as the Taiwan National Police Agency Criminal Investigation Bureau, the Financial Supervisory Service of South Korea, Thai Royal Police, the Fukuoka city and Shibuya City government, the Philippines Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Center, and the Royal Malaysia Police and state government to fight scam, dedicated to creating a "scam-free environment." **Why you should join Gogolook** * Influential products: What we make are meaningful products that create values for society and defend against frauds * Emphasize self-growth: We encourage technical community activities, subsidize tickets for conferences and workshops so that learning is continuously supported by the company * Unleash your talent: We respect the professional opinions of everyone, encourage team members to discuss with each other, and make awesome products together * Transparent culture: We publicly share the company's information to all, every member can read and feedback, and become a part of participating in the proposal **About The Role** The Gogolook Innovation Team is our MVP and innovation team. Its mission is to explore promising opportunities, turn Gogolook's anti-scam and trust capabilities into tangible product concepts, and deliver validated proofs of concept that can become the company's next products or growth engines. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to serve as the Innovation Team's Product Owner. You will lead 0 to 1 product discovery and validation: identifying meaningful problems, shaping opportunities, aligning a small cross-functional squad, shipping fast experiments, and gathering enough user and market evidence to recommend whether we should invest, iterate, pivot, or stop. This is not a conventional feature-delivery role with a predefined roadmap. You will often begin with an emerging technology, an internal capability, a customer signal, or an unresolved user problem. Your job is to connect the dots, define the product thesis, create momentum, and move the strongest ideas from concept to validated product direction. Recent initiatives have explored areas such as AI-agent safety, trust intelligence, scam-content detection, and new ways to bring Gogolook's anti-scam capabilities to global users and partners. The specific portfolio will continue to evolve. **Responsibilities** * Opportunity discovery: Continuously identify high-potential problems and market opportunities through user interviews, partner and business-team input, product data, technology trends, competitive research, and internal capability mapping * Product thesis and prioritization: Frame ambiguous ideas into clear problem statements, target users, value propositions, hypotheses, success criteria, risks, and investment recommendations. Compare opportunities and make explicit trade-offs * Rapid validation: Design the fastest credible path to test the riskiest assumptions, using prototypes, landing pages, concierge tests, technical spikes, or lightweight MVPs. Define what evidence is sufficient to proceed, pivot, or stop * 0 to 1 product ownership: Own the product direction, scope, backlog, and delivery cadence for selected initiatives. Write clear product requirements and keep the team focused on learning and outcomes rather than output alone * Cross-functional leadership: Lead a compact squad across engineering, design, AI/data, and other functions without relying on formal authority. Create clarity, unblock decisions, and maintain a fast, sustainable working rhythm * Capability productization: Work with platform and technology teams to translate APIs, models, datasets, and internal anti-scam capabilities into coherent user-facing or partner-facing products * Market validation and go-to-market: Partner with business development, marketing, and regional teams to test positioning, pricing or partnership assumptions, prepare demos and launch materials, recruit design partners, and capture market feedback * Technical and operational readiness: Coordinate dependencies such as API integration, reliability, analytics, privacy, security, legal review, and Responsible AI / data-governance requirements before external release * Evidence-based decisions: Define metrics and instrumentation, analyze quantitative and qualitative signals, and communicate concise recommendations to product and business leaders * Transition for scale: When an initiative is validated, prepare a clear handoff or incubation plan covering product scope, technical dependencies, operating model, risks, success metrics, and the next investment stage **Requirements** * 5+ years of experience in product management, product design, or venture building, including meaningful ownership of 0 to 1 digital products, new ventures, innovation programs, or early-stage product discovery * A track record of turning an ambiguous problem into a shipped experiment or MVP, learning from the market, and making a clear investment, pivot, or stop decision * Strong product judgment: able to distinguish an interesting technology from a valuable product opportunity and identify the smallest test that can reduce uncertainty * Strong execution skills across discovery, prioritization, product requirements, backlog management, delivery, launch, measurement, and iteration * Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills. Able to align executives and cross-functional teams, surface disagreement early, and drive decisions without formal authority * Sufficient technical fluency to work closely with engineers and AI/data teams on APIs, system constraints, integrations, and architecture trade-offs * Hands-on experience using AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, prototyping, documentation, or product operations - and the judgment to verify their output * Strong analytical ability. Comfortable defining metrics, interpreting product data, and using SQL, BI tools, or spreadsheets when needed to validate a decision * Full professional proficiency in Mandarin and English, with the ability to interview users, present ideas, and produce clear product documentation for international teams and partners * Comfort with uncertainty, changing priorities, incomplete information, and the possibility that a well-run experiment may end with a decision not to build **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building AI-native, cybersecurity, anti-scam, trust-and-safety, risk-management, identity, or developer-platform products * Familiarity with AI-agent ecosystems, LLM applications, Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent workflows, prompt injection, or emerging AI-security risks * Experience driving developer adoption through open-source projects, GitHub, developer communities, or marketplaces * Experience productizing internal technology or data capabilities into B2C, B2B, API, SaaS, or platform products * Experience launching or validating products in Europe or th
